description: Plan what a Solana mint attempt will cost, using LIVE getRecentPrioritizationFees samples for the collection's own writable accounts rather than any hardcoded figure. Requires the writable accounts, because querying without them returns the global per-slot minimum (usually zero) and tells you nothing about a contested mint. Reports that the fee is charged even when the mint LOSES. Read-only: builds no transaction and signs nothing.

computeUnitLimit.description: Measured CU limit from a simulation. Do NOT pad it: an inflated limit raises the scheduler's cost denominator and LOWERS priority at the same spend.

percentile.description: Percentile of observed fees to bid, 0-100. Default 75.

signatureCount.description: Default 2 — Candy Machine mintV1 needs a fresh ephemeral asset signer.

writableAccounts.description: The transaction's hot writable accounts, e.g. the candy machine address.

name: solana_mint_fee_plan
